# Secret Santa Project - Setup Instructions

## Project Overview
Full-stack Secret Santa application with Node.js/Express backend and React/Tailwind frontend.

## Features
- Admin panel to set participants and max gift price
- Users select name from dropdown and draw once (no re-draws)
- Cannot draw themselves
- Truly random assignment algorithm
- Results stored in NeDB (local non-relational database)
- Shareable link for all participants
- Clean and pleasant UI

## Project Structure
- `/backend` - Express server, API, NeDB database
- `/frontend` - React app with Tailwind CSS

## Setup Steps
1. ✅ Create copilot-instructions.md file
2. ✅ Scaffold project structure
3. ✅ Set up backend (Express + NeDB)
4. ✅ Implement random assignment algorithm
5. ✅ Create React frontend with Tailwind
6. ✅ Install dependencies
7. ✅ Create documentation

## All tasks completed!

## How to Run

### Terminal 1 - Backend:
```bash
cd backend
npm start
```

### Terminal 2 - Frontend:
```bash
cd frontend
npm start
```

The application will open at `http://localhost:3000`
